Use case: identity-preserve. Production pixel-art game spritesheet on true transparent RGBA background. Reference shows the protagonist identity: young slim indigenous Brazilian male, warm medium brown skin, black short tousled hair, two small white/red feathers on headband, bead necklace, brown simple loincloth belt with red center strip, wristbands and ankle tassels, barefoot. IMPORTANT redesign body to be distinctly SKINNY and lanky: narrow shoulders, small flat chest, thin arms, slim waist and legs, no bulky muscles, no bodybuilder abs. Keep same identity and all clothing in EVERY frame. Faces RIGHT, three-quarter side view. Crisp consistent pixel art, same warm natural palette, no white border, no checkerboard, no captions. Exact 8 equal columns and specified rows with wide clear transparent gutters, complete full body and effects inside each cell. Same body size and stable feet baseline, same camera, coherent chronological motion with real anticipation/intermediates/recovery, never duplicate mirrored or unrelated poses. Each row eight chronological animation frames.
Make EXACTLY SEVEN ROWS, EIGHT COLUMNS (56 figures). Row1 idle subtle breathe cycle: relaxed thin body, small shoulder/head/hand movement, closes loop. Row2 hurt: ready, flinch, recoil, recoil peak, regain balance, recover, relax, ready. Row3 basic punch: ready, guard, windup, extension, fist impact toward right, retract, recover, ready. Row4 victory loop: ready, lift fist, raise overhead, celebrate, hold fist, lower slightly, settle, ready. Row5 Mana Ancestral ultimate: ready, hands gather BLUE magic, cup blue light, lift arms to channel, release upward blue sparks, dissolve magic, lower arms, ready. Row6 Forcas Ancestrais ultimate: ready, bend knees, gather GOLD light, raise both hands, golden surge outward, golden sparks fade, relax, ready. Row7 Rugido da Floresta ultimate: ready, inhale, crouch channel GREEN forest energy, hands forward preparation, release roar right, recoil hands, recover, ready. Only small local magic around hands; NO separate animals or floating remote projectile in these body frames, those already exist as independent effects. Landscape sheet large enough for crisp eight-column anatomy.
